grants.title: Applying a Machine Learning and Causal Inference Approach to Analyzing Long-Term Sequelae of Viral Infection
grants.agency_name: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases
grants.description: Applies targeted machine learning and causal inference methods to data from the National COVID Cohort Collaborative (N3C) to study the long-term sequelae of COVID-19 infection.
